description: Monero mempool: pending transaction count, total bytes and fees, age of the oldest pending tx, double-spend/failing counts. When to use: is the network quiet or piling up, and roughly how long a new transaction waits. Do not use: for fees (xmr_get_fee_rates) or for a specific payment (xmr_get_transaction). Returns: pending_txs, bytes_total, fee_total_xmr, oldest_pending_age_s, double_spends, failing, tx_size_median_bytes, congestion verdict.
name: xmr_get_mempool_state
